purpose: House-style A/B/C calibration: same 6 canonical interests x 3 isolated global-style-block candidates = 18 images. Semantic hobby content must be byte-identical across A/B/C for the same hobby; only the top-level global_style prompt block differs. Test-only override, does not touch production global_style_v1.json.

expected.note: Input text token charges are additional but small relative to image output cost.

decision_gate.diagnostic: Does text-only style control make gemini-3.1-flash-lite-image produce a distinctive, non-photographic Zync collectible-illustration look? Score PHOTOGRAPHICNESS, COLLECTIBLE APPEAL, ZYNC DISTINCTIVENESS, MATURITY/PREMIUM FEEL, and SCALABILITY for each image, plus a separate semantic-correctness PASS/MINOR/FAIL.
decision_gate.fallback: If all three variants remain predominantly photographic, stop text-only style tweaking and recommend gemini-3.1-flash-image with reference-image conditioning as the next test, not another text-only round.
